definition: Each curve is one experiment unit; the panel compares units that differ in the conditions the legend names.
example: one curve per model run (Ylilammi Fig. 4)

definition: Each point or grid cell is one experiment unit; the axes are its conditions, the value or colour its result. Each grid point or scatter point is one unit; list every point as a run (or specimen) with its coordinates as its evidence (P145).
example: a heat map whose grid points are runs (axes = conditions, colour = result)

definition: The whole panel is one experiment unit; its curves are several results of one measurement or one model run: a panel whose curves are several results of one unit — a measured and a fitted profile, scans per element (P145; P146: the solution-method sentence lives in TERMS model run only).
example: an EDS panel = one specimen, its curves one measurement's results per element

definition: Each row is one experiment unit (a run, a specimen or a model run); the columns are its conditions and results.
The rows are not experiment units: a symbol table (symbol, meaning, value) or a comparison with the literature (cited values).
